stated_limitation: A nonparametric field over the 2D velocity plane is the best instantaneous model, so some structure remains that the parametric gain model does not capture.

justification.dataset: DANDI 000128 MC_Maze (Jenkins, M1/PMd delayed reaching) is the canonical dataset for reach direction and velocity tuning.
justification.handling: Real NWB file streamed via remfile with disk cache, kinematics correctly cached and decimated, neural lead estimated by a lag scan and applied consistently, alignment and units correct.
justification.analysis: Cosine tuning with a permutation test, circular PD estimates cross-checked two ways, cross-validated leave-one-out population vector, and a nested Poisson GLM ladder with a proper constant-rate null are all standard and correctly done.
justification.correctness: Decoding and GLM headline numbers reproduce exactly from the committed npz/logs, are internally consistent with the figures, and rest on adequate samples and correct tests.
justification.figures: Figures show the effects clearly with labeled axes, units, and trial counts; the best-fit gallery is honestly labeled and accompanied by full population distributions and an exemplar unit.
justification.honesty: Claims are proportionate, and the write-up explicitly flags a misleading negative result and admits the 2D field beats the parametric gain model, acknowledging residual structure and the single session.
